notes.title: tinyBuild's hosting a carnival of games at PAXSouth
notes.content:
[img]https://imgur.com/ZCsV3pc.gif[/img]

Hello gamers! 

I've not been posting much to our publisher page because cross-posting is currently very wonky, so it's been mostly to individual pages of games.

This weekend we're hosting a full on orange Carnival at PAXSouth, featuring lots and lots of games!

[h1]Secret Neighbor[/h1]

Secret Neighbor is getting a full on booth, so come over to say hi and show the game to your friends. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/859570/Secret_Neighbor/

[h1]Black Skylands[/h1]

I believe Black Skylands has best in class pixelart, and gameplay to match. The newest demo takes you on a journey through gorgeous floating islands filled with things that want you dead.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1143810/Black_Skylands/

[h1]Totally Reliable Delivery Service[/h1]

Delivery attempted. That's the guarantee of this totally accurate representation of package delivery drivers. We've all had this happen to us, so now it's time to make fun of it in a physics filled sandbox!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1011670/Totally_Reliable_Delivery_Service/

[h1]Hellpoint[/h1]

The latest build of Hellpoint showcases the "Dark Souls in Space" game's progress, and we're eager to see what fans think

https://store.steampowered.com/app/628670/Hellpoint/

[h1]Merch! Fun! Attractions![/h1]

Aside from actual games we have a whole setup for fun family friendly activities, featuring merch you can win. 

[img]https://imgur.com/9FwilNg.png[/img]

[img]https://imgur.com/xV5LEWT.png[/img]

It's only 2 days left until Secret Neighbor launches on Steam!

Today I bring you brand new footage in the form of a How To Play video. It's recorded from the release version of the game, and I'm sure you'll enjoy spotting the progress we've made. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n7VfXn2e7j4&feature=youtu.be

During the lead up to Secret Neighbor I've also launched all of the Hello Neighbor Alphas. You can check them out on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/franchise/helloneighbor]this page [/url]

notes.title: Secret Neighbor coming Oct 24 / Pre-Alpha of HN live
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/1es15gx.gif[/img]

Good news, everyone!

Secret Neighbor, the multiplayer spin-off of Hello Neighbor, is coming to Steam on October 24th. That's exactly in 2 weeks!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/LH4FkwV.gif[/img]

Remember to Wishlist the game so you're notified of when it launches: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/859570/Secret_Neighbor/

[h1]To celebrate the anticipated launch, we are launching the Alphas on Steam[/h1]

I know many of you have been waiting for the release of the original Hello Neighbor Alphas. It's 2 weeks until launch of Secret Neighbor, and there are 5 alpha builds. I will be launching a new alpha every few days leading up to launch. 

The Alphas of Hello Neighbor were a series of game builds we used to test out the original game's gameplay, setting, lore, and AI. They show the logical evolution of how the game became Hello Neighbor. 

I just launched the first Pre-Alpha build. Enjoy:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1092700/Hello_Neighbor_PreAlpha/
